Our consolidated power sales volume was higher by nearly 17%, reaching 29 billion units against 25 billion units in quarter 1 last year.

Our tariff realization under PPA improved by 8% to INR5.93 per unit and merchant and short-term realization improved by 13% to INR7.04 per unit, directly benefiting from the strong demand environment.
The Fuel cost for the quarter was higher by 30% at INR9,513 crores, which was driven by larger dispatch volumes and higher imported imported coal indices.

rating.label: ICRA rating
rating.summary: However, ICRA expects the leverage level to continue at comfortable levels, with total net debt/OPBDITA projected to remain below 2.75x on a sustained basis. Nonetheless, ICRA notes that execution has progressed well on the near-term project (Korba Phase-II Unit-3 was synchronised with the grid in October 2026 and Mahan Phase-II was about 92% complete as on September 30, 2026).
